title: Selection and Application of Accounting Policies

content.definition: Specific principles, bases, conventions, rules, and practices applied in preparing financial statements
content.key_principle: Select policies that result in information that is relevant and faithfully represents economic substance

gaap_hierarchy.category_b: If no specific guidance in Codification, consider: FASB Concepts Statements, AICPA Issues Papers, other guidance (non-authoritative)
gaap_hierarchy.apply_professional_judgment: If no authoritative guidance, use judgment based on conceptual framework

common_policy_choices.inventory: FIFO, weighted average (LIFO eliminated in some contexts)
common_policy_choices.depreciation: Straight-line, declining balance, units of production
common_policy_choices.revenue_recognition: Point in time vs over time (based on ASC 606 criteria)
common_policy_choices.investments: Fair value through NI, fair value through OCI, amortized cost
common_policy_choices.consolidation: Equity method, consolidation, fair value option

disclosure_requirements.note_1: Summary of significant accounting policies typically first note
disclosure_requirements.new_policies: Disclose newly adopted policies or changes

consistency_principle.require_consistency: Apply same policies from period to period
consistency_principle.changes_allowed: Can change if new policy preferable (requires retrospective application typically)
consistency_principle.disclosure: Changes in policies require disclosure and restatement

substance_over_form.principle: Select policies that reflect economic substance, not just legal form
substance_over_form.example: Lease accounted as finance lease if transfers substantially all risks/rewards, even if legal title doesn't transfer

conservatism_in_policy_selection.historical: When in doubt, recognize losses but not gains
conservatism_in_policy_selection.current_framework: Neutrality emphasized (don't deliberately understate or overstate)
conservatism_in_policy_selection.practical: Conservative policies may still be selected if justified

industry_specific_policies.specialized_industries: Construction, insurance, banking, oil & gas have specific guidance

policy_application_errors.error: Mistake in applying policy (math error, oversight)
policy_application_errors.change_in_policy: Voluntary change from one acceptable method to another
policy_application_errors.change_in_estimate: Change based on new information (not error or policy change)
policy_application_errors.correction: Errors corrected retrospectively. Policy changes retrospective. Estimates prospective.

management_judgment.document_rationale: Document basis for judgments (internal control, audit trail)

cpa_exam_tips: Accounting policies: Specific principles applied in preparing financial statements
GAAP hierarchy: ASC is authoritative. If no guidance, use judgment and concepts.
Note 1: Summary of significant accounting policies (required disclosure)
Consistency: Apply same policies unless change is preferable (retrospective)
Substance over form: Policies reflect economic substance
Industry practices: Consider comparability within industry

key_points: Accounting policies: Specific principles applied in preparing FS
GAAP hierarchy: ASC authoritative, concepts and judgment if no guidance
Consistency: Same policies period to period unless change preferable
Substance over form: Reflect economic substance
Selection factors: Relevance, faithful representation, comparability, neutrality
